messages:
nina: following up from the postmortem thread — recurring paging pattern for the batch-backfill job. goal: reduce noise and make remediation self-serve.

omar: I can take the alert tuning. current behavior: fires ~6x overnight during backlog. proposed: move from instant count -> 10m avg and add a rising-rate window (two consecutive 10m samples). will open PR with before/after fire counts. target: Wed EOD.
	erry: i'll do dedupe + routing. idea: dedupe by job_id + region; route pages for backfills to a lower-priority rota and tag alerts `severity:low` during scheduled windows. will put up config in staging for QA. PR target: Fri.

kelly: ops items: add a one-click runbook button in the alert (link to backfill runbook) and document escalation steps. i'll coordinate with eng to ensure the runbook includes a manual cancel for the job and how to patch the backfill window. ETA: 1 week.

oncall-bot: incident 2841234567 resolved by nina  duration 1h05m  runbook: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2841234567 (auto)

nina: acceptance criteria suggestion: 14-day rolling decrease in pages during backfill window >= 80% and documented runbook steps + tests in runbook playbook. owners must attach dashboard screenshots to close items.

omar: added a small synthetic that simulates backlog and will compare firing counts. will annotate PR with the synthetic results.

terry: routing config snippet i'll include:
```yaml
alert: backfill-error-rate
condition: avg_over_time(10m) > 0.05
labels:
  severity: low
routing: "ops-low-priority-rota"
dedupe_key: "job_id:region"
```

kelly: schedule: omar PR Wed, terry PR Fri, runbook draft by next Tues. set a review checkpoint next-wed 9am to review dashboards. /remind @ops-team review checkpoint next_wed 09:00

nina: sounds good. please also add a note in the runbook to temporarily disable suppression if a correlated service alert (db-error-rate) is firing. we don't want to mask real risk.

omar: noted, I'll add correlation logic: if db-error-rate > 0 -> bypass suppression.

terry: deploying a staging patch now to test dedupe keys; will post results in this thread.

kelly: added a placeholder runbook section and linked to the postmortem. will update with screenshots once PRs land.

nina: thanks everyone — update the postmortem action list with PR links and close when acceptance criteria are met. I'll run the checkpoint and mark items closed. :white_check_mark:
